notes.title: v1.5.5 - Improved settings
notes.content:
The following improvements were applied in this version:


 Language can now be changed from the settings.
 Settings are saved and loaded when the game is launched again.
 Game is now set to 60 FPS, which is configurable from the settings.
 There was a bug causing the game's guide cards to appear every time, which is now fixed to appear only the first time.
 Updated credits

notes.title: v1.5.3 - German, Japanese and minor improvements
notes.content:
Add german language
 Add japanese language
 Minor improvements in the animations while menuing

notes.title: v1.4.1 - Greek localisation and more
notes.content:
Added new functionaltiy to render fonts with Unicode characters through UTF-8.
 First pass of Greek localisations added. It will either pick Steam's default language, or you can select a custom language through the game's properties before launching it.
 New icons are added in the text effect of all cards. They show which special icon is needed to activate the effect of a card.
 Copy in the game was revisited and improved, both on how it looks and how clear it is.

notes.title: v1.0.7 - Release
notes.content:
A new Virtual Reality version is now available!

I’ve finally added VR support on avdl - my programming language - allowing me to compile projects for the Oculus machines.

At the time, only the Quest 2 is officially supported, but given that this is a free and open-source game, feel free to try it out on any other oculus hardware. Any feedback is greatly appreciated!

Here’s a new video showing the VR gameplay:

[previewyoutube=ONLWetKVboE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

You can also check out Rue on Oculus App Lab

Get Rue - the physical card game

A new link is added in the main menu, allowing users that enjoy the game to purchase the physical card game, so they can play live with friends.

You can find it on my etsy shop: Afloofdev - Etsy Shop

Performance improvements

General improvements on performance, should mean the game can now run on even weaker hardware. I’ve tested this with a very old laptop of mine and the game runs without error or lag!

notes.title: Update v0.4.0
notes.content:
New build uploaded, that organised the game a bit better. It also added a variety of features:


15 completed cards with artwork.
1 new background environment.
5 different AI opponents.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41042235/102d90f407353e8b6c48f9bf0a802111cce73502.png


15 different stages to complete, each with increasing difficulty.
The game now features Steam achievements! Can you get them all?
Implemented “Optional effects”, which allow the user to discard another card, to increase the effect of their current card.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41042235/9337ff58cf6cbd9cc6c7714db75b068f2532d3b4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41042235/39bb9e6abe452391a2313945be67fc1f55f401b5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41042235/4e581531187118f77725ac4ed5938190c1ff9016.png


The first few levels now show less cards, making it easier for the user to get used to the game, before introducing cards with more complex effects.
Despite all the new features, the new binaries for Linux and Windows are almost half the size of the previous version, thanks to some optimisations (from ~40MB to ~20MB).


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41042235/75d51542f40053a91ab69c4318464c31349850bd.png
